rv.q: Intelligent, if too even-toned to thrill, it unfolds with rare clarity.
This shaven-headed, smooth-talking conman can play everyone for a fool.
This Othello , directed by Tim Carroll, is both bold and flawed.

cn.t: Mixed reviews for this RSC *Othello*: critics praise John Douglas Thompson's commanding performance and the production's clarity, but find it too even-toned to fully ignite. Intelligent and fresh, yet lacking the emotional charge Shakespeare's tragedy demands.
